summary: Policy enforcement at runtime uses Open Policy Agent (OPA) to evaluate Rego policies and stops actions that violate them. It needs a reachable OPA server, authentication settings and a policy associated with an organization, inventory or job template; only OPA API v1 is supported.
questions: How does policy enforcement work in AAP 2.6?
